q-129171:
First, we notice:

- For the plane $5x-2z+13=0,$ a normal vector to the plane is ${n}_{1}=⟨5,0,-2⟩.$

- For the plane $2y-3z-25=0,$ a normal vector to the plane is ${n}_{2}=⟨0,2,-3⟩.$

To find a direction vector for the line, we calculate the cross product of these normal vectors:

$$
\begin{aligned}v & ={n}_{1}\times {n}_{2} \\  & =⟨5,0,-2⟩\times ⟨0,2,-3⟩ \\  & =\left|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ 5 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 2 & -3\end{aligned}\right| \\  & =4i+15j+10k \\  & =⟨4,15,10⟩\end{aligned}
$$
